name: 项目综合看板
description: 一级看板：项目综合态势总览，进度为主轴 + 异常标红，核心维度：项目 + 科室。

metricNote.definition: 周期内有进度数据上报的不同项目数(去重)
metricNote.formula: 周期内出现过的不同项目编号去重计数
metricNote.scope: 进度信息汇总表中 plan_month 落在周期内的项目

sqlConfig.query: WITH progress AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.project_no) AS project_total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.incomplete_cnt > 0 THEN s.project_no END) AS project_active, SUM(s.completed_total_cnt) AS completed_sum, SUM(s.due_cnt + s.outside_completed_cnt) AS due_sum FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')), quality AS (SELECT SUM(q.open_issue_cnt) AS open_quality_issues FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')), tech AS (SELECT SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii) AS pending_reform_cnt FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')), risk AS (SELECT SUM(r.high_cnt) AS high_risk_cnt FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 r WHERE r.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND r.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')) SELECT p.project_total AS "项目总数", p.project_active AS "进行中项目", CASE WHEN p.due_sum = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.completed_sum::numeric / p.due_sum::numeric * 100, 1) END AS "项目完成率", COALESCE(q.open_quality_issues, 0) AS "未闭环质量问题数", COALESCE(t.pending_reform_cnt, 0) AS "未整改落实技术更改单数", COALESCE(r.high_risk_cnt, 0) AS "高风险数量" FROM progress p, quality q, tech t, risk r

metricNote.definition: 周期内已到时间的节点中,已完成节点的占比(含周期外完成)
metricNote.formula: (按时完成节点数 + 超期完成节点数 + 周期外完成节点数) ÷ (已到时间节点数 + 周期外完成节点数) × 100%
metricNote.scope: 已到时间节点 = 周期内总节点 - 正常待完成节点
metricNote.excelRef: 原始指标 #9 节点完成百分比

sqlConfig.query: SELECT COALESCE(d.dept,'未填') AS "科室", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "按时完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_pending_normal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "正常待完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_completed_effective THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "超期完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_incomplete_effective THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "超期未完成" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM') GROUP BY d.dept ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.new_issue_cnt), 0) AS "质量问题总数" FROM biz_ads_quality_kpi_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')

WITH latest_month AS (SELECT MAX(q.period_month) AS period_month FROM biz_ads_quality_kpi_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.new_issue_cnt), 0) AS "当月新增" FROM latest_month lm LEFT JOIN biz_ads_quality_kpi_v2 q ON q.period_month = lm.period_month

WITH latest_month AS (SELECT MAX(q.period_month) AS period_month FROM biz_ads_quality_kpi_v2 q WHERE q.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND q.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.open_issue_cnt), 0) AS "未归零" FROM latest_month lm LEFT JOIN biz_ads_quality_kpi_v2 q ON q.period_month = lm.period_month

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.total_change_cnt), 0) AS "技术状态变更总数" FROM biz_ads_tech_state_kpi_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')

WITH latest_month AS (SELECT MAX(t.period_month) AS period_month FROM biz_ads_tech_state_kpi_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(t.file_unsigned_i_ii, 0) + COALESCE(t.file_unsigned_iii, 0)), 0) AS "未签署" FROM latest_month lm LEFT JOIN biz_ads_tech_state_kpi_v2 t ON t.period_month = lm.period_month

WITH latest_month AS (SELECT MAX(t.period_month) AS period_month FROM biz_ads_tech_state_kpi_v2 t WHERE t.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND t.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM')) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.reform_pending_i_ii), 0) AS "未落实整改" FROM latest_month lm LEFT JOIN biz_ads_tech_state_kpi_v2 t ON t.period_month = lm.period_month

sqlConfig.query:
SELECT v."风险类型", v."数量" FROM (
SELECT '技术' AS "风险类型", SUM(s.cat_technical_cnt) AS "数量" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM')
UNION ALL SELECT '进度', SUM(s.cat_schedule_cnt)  FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM')
UNION ALL SELECT '成本', SUM(s.cat_cost_cnt)      FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM')
UNION ALL SELECT '设计', SUM(s.cat_design_cnt)    FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM')
UNION ALL SELECT '质量', SUM(s.cat_quality_cnt)   FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM')
UNION ALL SELECT '其他', SUM(s.cat_other_cnt)     FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date,'YYYY-MM')
) v WHERE v."数量" > 0

sqlConfig.query: WITH project_rollup AS (SELECT d.project_no, MAX(NULLIF(btrim(d.project_manager), '')) AS project_manager, MAX(NULLIF(btrim(d.institute_leader), '')) AS institute_leader, COUNT(*) AS node_cnt FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.project_no IS NOT NULL AND d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') GROUP BY d.project_no) SELECT r.project_no AS "项目名称", COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' / ', r.project_manager, r.institute_leader), ''), '--') AS "项目两总", '--' AS "项目经费(万)" FROM project_rollup r ORDER BY r.node_cnt DESC, r.project_no LIMIT 8
